injuries.longComment: Hutchinson hurt himself on the first possession of Sunday's game after sacking New England's Drake Maye, after which he went to the locker room and eventually was ruled out. Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reported Monday that initial testing revealed an ACL, which now has been confirmed after additional testing. Hutchinson will turn his focus to getting healthy for 2027, though considering the timing of the ACL tear, he may be in danger of being sidelined for Week 1.
injuries.shortComment: Tests Monday have confirmed that Hutchinson sustained a torn ACL in his right knee during Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich, but he avoided any other significant damage, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.
